ADVANCED

Picking up from Security, where trust boundaries were drawn — shared libraries run outside the sandbox, so that trust model governs them.

01 / Shared Libraries

// Jenkinsfile: one line replaces 60 of boilerplate @Library('acme-pipeline-lib@1.4') _ standardServicePipeline(app: 'shop', deployEnv: 'staging')
RULES — version the lib (@1.4, never @main) · test with JenkinsPipelineUnit before tagging · only admins approve library repos (unsandboxed).

02 / Parallel & Matrix

Parallelize independent verification (unit/lint/scan), never dependent deploys. Matrix multiplies stages × axes (JDK 17/21, browsers). Size agent pools for peak fan-out, not average load.

03 / Controller From YAML

# jenkins.yaml — identical controller every boot jenkins: { numExecutors: 0 } credentials: { system: { … registry-token: "${REGISTRY_TOKEN}" } } # boot: pinned image + plugins.txt + jenkins.yaml. UI drift is ephemeral.

04 / Backup, Console, Tuning

  • Backup JENKINS_HOME minus workspaces; restore jobs + credentials + config + YAML + plugins. Untested backup = rumor. Encrypt off-site.
  • Script Console = Groovy as admin; audit every run; never paste blind snippets.
  • Queue — executors ≤ ~1 per 1–2 cores; heap ≥ 4 GB (-Xmx4g); stagger cron (H 9 * * *); quiet periods batch rapid commits.
PROD TOPOLOGY — active-passive controllers from one jenkins.yaml + replicated storage · agent fleets per team/env (labels route) · controller private behind TLS proxy, agents outbound-only · quarterly DR restore drill measured against RTO.

05 / Interview Check

Q: Roll out a shared library to 50 repos?
A: Version + unit-test the lib, migrate one pilot repo, pin tags, admin-approve the repo (unsandboxed trust).
Q: Rebuild-a-controller drill order?
A: Image → plugins → JCasC → secrets → backup restore → smoke pipeline. Secrets break first.
